_comment: Items: gear, tools and buildings (DESIGN.md 4.3). Seeded as data so balance can be retuned without a deploy. Gear bonuses are deliberately larger than the equivalent Bonus Point upgrade but slot-competing, so the two acquisition routes do not merely duplicate each other. Tools carry a secondary modifier: ToolTier gates which tiers are reachable, GatherSpeedPercent reduces gather time within a tier (4.3). Both on one item, because two items competing for the single Tool slot would make the speed bonus unusable.

items.name: Forager's Satchel
items.description: +20% skill XP. Competes with other body gear.

items.name: Surveyor's Lens
items.description: +1 cell reveal radius. Every step paints a wider corridor.

items.name: Traveller's Boots
items.description: +25m POI interact range. Reaches POIs across a road.

items.name: Hearthstone Charm
items.description: +4h offline accrual. Bank a whole night rather than half of one.

items.name: Foraging Knife
items.description: A basic blade. Permits gathering up to tier 3.

items.name: Harvest Sickle
items.description: Properly weighted. Permits gathering up to tier 5.

items.name: Storehouse
items.description: +50% stack caps. Placed on a Claim.

items.name: Worker's Lodge
items.description: +30% worker output. Placed on a Claim.

items.name: Stone Tools
items.description: Rough, but they work. Reaches tier 1.

items.name: Copper Pickaxe
items.description: A real pickaxe. Reaches tier 2, and swings faster.

items.name: Meteoric Gear
items.description: Not from around here. Reaches tier 7.

items.name: Padded Jerkin
items.description: Fights as +3 Combat levels. Competes with other body gear.

items.name: Campaigner's Helm
items.description: Fights as +5 Combat levels. Dented, and still worn.

items.name: Warlord's Signet
items.description: Fights as +8 Combat levels, and +10% skill XP. Someone commanded with this.
